name: Product Return Requests for WooCommerce
author: Atakan Au

sections.description:
Product Return Requests Manager for WooCommerce is a plugin that allows store owners to manage product return requests in WooCommerce. This plugin provides an easy interface for customers to request returns and for store owners to process those requests.

Support

Support requests, bug reports, feedback, and feature requests can be submitted via the support forum or the plugin’s blog page.

If you find the plugin useful, please consider leaving a 5-star review. You can also support my work with a donation.

Collaboration

I am a freelance developer available for custom development, integrations, and technical consulting. If you have a project related to this plugin, feel free to get in touch.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-return-requests-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I enable product return requests?

After installing and activating the plugin, you can use product return requests from “My account” page on the frontend.

Use a permalink structure that differs from the default “index.php” or “?p=123” (Plain) options.
